title: Doctor reports inconclusive runtime catalog while preserving static skill checks
description: Verifies harness:doctor reports runtime verification inconclusive when OpenCode server is unreachable while still reporting static skill validation results.

preconditions.repoState: isolated project with installed OpenCode harness and unreachable OpenCode server

events: Operator runs harness:doctor against isolated project

assertions: Doctor reports runtime catalog check as inconclusive
Static procedure-skill check results are still printed
observableFinalState: doctor output includes static skill status and inconclusive runtime status
no installed config files are modified

provenance.sourceSummary: Held-out validation scenario #90007 for doctor static-vs-runtime separation on unreachable host.
